cohort: 406 patients who required ECMO support at a single institution, with 10 patients specifically switched to veno-veno-arterial (v-v-a) ECMO.
finding: Veno-veno-arterial ECMO is a technically feasible rescue strategy for treating patients with combined respiratory and haemodynamic failure.
mod_finding: This study mentions a case where respiratory failure occurred after a cesarean section, requiring ECMO support.
